title: REQ · UI store holds sound and settings flags with toggleSound and toggleSettings
summary: Sound and settings flags in useUiStore
description: Context: the header needs sound and settings controls. Desired behavior: the store has soundEnabled (default true) and settingsOpen (default false), with toggleSound and toggleSettings. Expected result: each toggle flips only its own flag. Why: the header sound button and settings control depend on this state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when read, then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen is false
Given the store, when toggleSound is called, then soundEnabled flips and settingsOpen is unchanged
Given the store, when toggleSettings is called, then settingsOpen flips and soundEnabled is unchanged
definition_of_done: Flags and toggles exist and are typed
